run_collect_env: run the collect_env.py module to gather and print PyTorch system environment information
get_env_info: get a SystemEnv namedtuple containing torch version, CUDA info, GPU models, and installed packages
get_pretty_env_info: get a formatted string of the full PyTorch environment diagnostic report
test_get_cpu_info: test the get_cpu_info function to retrieve CPU details from lscpu, wmic, or sysctl
review_get_cudnn_version: review the get_cudnn_version function that locates and returns installed cuDNN library files
